import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

base = Path('products/services/catalogue-one-command-qa')
runner = base / 'run_example.py'
old = 'sys.exit(subprocess.run([sys.executable, "verify_example.py"], cwd=base).returncode)'
new = '''sys.exit(subprocess.run([
        sys.executable,
        str(base / "verify_example.py"),
        str(base / "fixtures/before-variants.csv"),
        str(images),
        str(output),
    ], cwd=base).returncode)'''
source = runner.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
if source.count(old) == 1:
    source = source.replace(old, new)
elif source.count(new) != 1:
    raise SystemExit('Runner changed since the observed failure. Inspect the committed revision before patching.')
files = ['run_example.py', 'transform.py', 'verify.py', 'verify_example.py', 'fixtures/before-variants.csv', 'fixtures/before-images.csv', 'fixtures/after-shopify.csv']

def run(command, directory):
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=directory, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    return {'command': [Path(command[0]).name, *command[1:]], 'exit_code': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr}

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    fresh = Path(directory)
    for name in files:
        target = fresh / name
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(base / name, target)
    (fresh / 'run_example.py').write_text(source, encoding='utf-8')
    clean = run([sys.executable, 'run_example.py'], fresh)
    images = (fresh / 'fixtures/before-images.csv').read_bytes()
    duplicate = fresh / 'duplicate-images.csv'
    duplicate.write_bytes(images.rstrip(b'\r\n') + b'\n' + images.splitlines()[1] + b'\n')
    negative = run([sys.executable, 'run_example.py', '--images', duplicate.name], fresh)
    hashes = {name: hashlib.sha256((fresh / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in files}

passed = clean['exit_code'] == 0 and negative['exit_code'] != 0 and 'style SH-100: same image URL used twice' in negative['stderr']
report = {'scope': 'Offline synthetic worked example with clean and duplicate-image controls', 'clean': clean, 'duplicate': negative, 'passed': passed, 'baseline_l71': {'downloads': 7, 'commands': 2}, 'trial': {'files_to_place': len(files), 'commands_after_placement': 1, 'negative_control_generated_separately': True}, 'sha256': hashes}
receipt = base / 'runner-corrected-smoke.json'
receipt.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
if passed:
    runner.write_text(source, encoding='utf-8')
print(receipt.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
